figurative_meaning_en: one's own and others; allies and opponents
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনে শত্রুমিত্র সবাইকে মেনে নিতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: In politics, the game of friends and foes continues.
In life, one has to accept both allies and opponents.
note: The idiom reflects binary relationships common in Bengali discourse.
